branding.tagline: Drafts on-brand posts, articles and emails, and keeps your content calendar on track.

description: Plans campaigns and drafts social posts, articles, emails and simple visuals in your brand's voice. Each draft is saved to a folder for its content type and booked into WorkQ with review and publish dates. It never posts or sends anything for you, and never invents prices, dates, offers or testimonials.

outcomes: Every post, article and email is drafted in your brand's voice from your Brand Kit
Nothing is invented: missing prices, dates or offers are flagged for you to fill in
Nothing goes on your calendar as ready until a named reviewer approves that exact draft
Every approved draft is saved in a folder for its content type, ready to copy and post
Nothing is ever posted or sent for you
